label_usage: Independent cohort QA/sampling and evaluation only; never a model feature

diagnostic_cohort.selection: label-stratified within each fixed time partition; not population precision

natural_cohort.selection: stable hash, label-blind within each fixed time partition

history: Only transactions before case_as_of; prior raw history may be used but no labels or cross-split memory. Such overlap is reported, not claimed as account-disjoint validation.
test_access: QA aggregate counts may be inspected before implementation; case-level outcomes remain held out; no test-driven tuning
outside_range: Retained in source; excluded from this first experiment, including long timestamp tail
